_comment: Generated by our version (wr_stages.py) from the WRCG inventory; edit freely.
name: WrcgKeSS2
manual_notes: KE_KENYA/SS2: Seyabei, Safari Rally Kenya, 6250 m, gravel; WRCG tag SS2.

solid_props M_RED_ROCK / CLIFF_MODULAR (owner 2026-11-14): the big red rocks and cliffs next to the road were driven through; forced as PM_WallRock obstacles (wr_fixes._patch_solid_props). First try, check in game.
net_solid (owner 2026-11-14): the red plastic nets were driven through (cloth, no collision in WRCG); thin two-sided walls from wr_fixes._net_collision. Tape stays without collision.
own_spawners_only (owner 2026-11-14): posts of KE_ES1_/KE_SS2R_ spline spawners stood in the middle of SS2's road; only SS2's spawners and the shared ones are kept (wr_fixes._own_spawners).

rock_solid (owner 2026-11-14): the grey medium stones (species rock, SmallLimestone) were driven through; ellipsoid obstacles from wr_fixes._rock_collision. Size from mesh bounds x scale 5..9 (assumed), PM_WallRock.
fence_solid (owner 2026-11-14): the wire fences (High_Fence_*_Spawner) were driven through; walls between neighbouring posts, never across the route (wr_fixes._fence_collision).

auto_crowd (owner 2026-11-14): extra spectator clusters on the outside of tight corners (wr_autocrowd.py); WRCG's own spots and props left alone. ACACIA/BAOBAB/EUPHORBE now mapped by wr_fixes.AUTO_RULES (Kenya vegetation).
road_tint (owner 2026-11-14): road gravel textures x [1.1,0.8,0.62] linear, redder/browner like arid Mexico; only the road, not the terrain.
crowd_penalty (owner 2026-11-14): hidden BC_CornerCutting_Cone actors in front of the crowd + DA_RacePenaltyDataFreePractice with PropsCollision 20 s (wr_penalty.py). EXPERIMENT, not checked in game.
animals (owner 2026-11-14): WRCG's flamingos and giraffes of SS2/KE_SS2_GRAPH/ANIMALS as frozen props (wr_animals.py). Cows = WRCG's BUFFALO01 (ACR has no cow model).
support_vehicles (owner 2026-11-14): ACR's ambulance, security car and van cloned from Monte Carlo cells behind the biggest crowd clusters (wr_support.py).
terrain_match (owner 2026-11-14): terrain soil textures matched to the road's tinted gravel colour, so no lighter sand patches.
ground_cover_pebbles 0.2 (owner 2026-11-14): ACR's pale Greek limestones read as white patches on Kenya's red earth; small pebbles at 20% (gc_stone only; gc_rock keeps its collision).
stop_after_m 100 (owner 2026-11-14): the stop control (booth) and the finish marshal together 100 m after the line (WRCG's was 62), more room to brake; marshal back at Hafren's 3.3 m past the booth.
wrcg_tape_post_physics: keep WRCG ribbon and original metal posts, with ACR physics for posts clear of the road. brake_boards: raised ACR 100 m and 50 m signs with bases.
2026-11-15 reverted: tape_posts (wooden posts blocked the start), stick_solid and road_track_texture/tint (no visible gain) are off; the code stays in wr_tapeposts.py / wr_fixes.py.

2026-11-15 (owner): the zone at route m 2984-3102 (signs + red net + large green net) was very dark; the red net is left out there (cloth_skip) and the large green net is lightened (cloth_tint x2.0/2.4/1.7). Hypothesis: the red net caused it; untested.
2026-11-15 (owner): local fill removed after the tree-shadow adjustment. Red net restored (cloth_skip removed), green net keeps cloth_tint, daytime sky light x1.25.
2026-11-15 (owner): far_tree_light 0.45/1.3 improved the far trees a lot; raised to 0.65/1.0.
